hunks.baseline: Then he said the one thing more than enough to make Gong Ilhyuk lose his reason.
hunks.sol: Then he said the one thing guaranteed to make Gong Ilhyuk lose all reason.

hunks.baseline: “Wow, this is the first time anyone’s ever sworn at me. How fascinating.”
hunks.sol: “Wow, no one’s ever sworn at me before. This is fascinating.”

hunks.baseline: Crack. Crunch.
hunks.sol: Crack! Crunch!

hunks.baseline: Amid the silent shock, one man opened his mouth wide in pain.
hunks.sol: Amid the stunned silence, one man’s mouth fell open in agony.

hunks.baseline: His fist had been crushed. Bone jutted through the torn flesh of his forearm, and blood covered Gong Ilhyuk as he asked in a trembling voice,
hunks.sol: His fist had been crushed. Bone jutted through the torn flesh of his forearm, and Gong Ilhyuk, drenched in blood, asked in a trembling voice,

hunks.baseline: “Wh-what is this? What kind of fist technique…?”
hunks.sol: “Wh-what was that? What kind of fist technique…?”

hunks.baseline: If he hadn’t asked, I would have asked the same thing.
hunks.sol: If he hadn’t asked, I would have.

hunks.baseline: I had expected this result, but not to this extent.
hunks.sol: I’d expected this outcome, but not anything this extreme.

hunks.baseline: With a single counter, Cheongpung had rendered Gong Ilhyuk, a Level 70-plus master, completely helpless.
hunks.sol: With a single counter, Cheongpung had rendered Gong Ilhyuk, a master above Level 70, completely helpless.

hunks.baseline: And then…
hunks.sol: And…

hunks.baseline: “It wasn’t a fist technique.”
hunks.sol: “That wasn’t a fist technique.”

hunks.baseline: At my mutter, Cheongpung answered with a face that looked ready to vomit.
hunks.sol: At my murmur, Cheongpung answered with a face that looked ready to vomit.

hunks.baseline: “Benefactor is right. It wasn’t a fist technique. It was a palm technique called the Taeeul Miri Palm. But Senior, you’re bleeding too much. The smell of blood is making my stomach churn. Urk!”
hunks.sol: “Benefactor is right. It wasn’t a fist technique. It was a palm technique called the Taeeul Miri Palm. But Senior, you’re bleeding so much. The smell is making me sick. Urk!”

hunks.baseline: I gave a hollow laugh as Cheongpung flung Gong Ilhyuk aside and began dry heaving.
hunks.sol: I let out a hollow laugh as Cheongpung flung Gong Ilhyuk aside and began to dry-heave.

hunks.baseline: Li Feng asked with his eyes wide.
hunks.sol: Li Feng’s eyes widened.

hunks.baseline: “Did you just say Taeeul Miri Palm? Are you certain?”
hunks.sol: “Did you say the Taeeul Miri Palm? Are you certain?”

hunks.baseline: “M-May I ask his name?”
hunks.sol: “M-may I ask his name?”

hunks.baseline: “Mae Jonghak, urk—urgh!”
hunks.sol: “Urk, Mae Jonghak—bleeegh!”

hunks.baseline: Splash!
hunks.sol: Splat!

hunks.baseline: I was shocked that Cheongpung had vomited in the very place where the king was about to arrive, but Li Feng seemed unfazed.
hunks.sol: I was shocked that Cheongpung had just vomited where His Highness would soon arrive, but Li Feng didn’t seem to care.

hunks.baseline: He trembled as though he had been struck by lightning, then squeezed out a single word.
hunks.sol: Trembling as though struck by lightning, he forced out the words.

hunks.baseline: “Sword Saint…”
hunks.sol: “The Sword Saint…!”
